buyer.name: MEPflow
buyer.sourceNotes: Published product already includes office/field scheduling, estimates, invoices, costing and texting. Homepage offers founder-assisted migration of existing customer and job data and a full data export on exit. The inspected public page does not publish machine import headers, status codes or an import API. Target columns, target version and actual acceptance must be supplied by the receiving team.

operators.name: Action Heating and Cooling LLC
operators.workflow: Family HVAC business serving Northwest Arkansas; published staff separates an office role from field technicians. Installation, repair and maintenance are distinct services; public inquiry asks name, phone, email and message.
operators.commissioningFocus: Keep customer identity, site and repair/install/maintenance classification separate. Preserve original technician and office references as source fields; do not infer a current software vendor or actual export schema.

operators.name: United Plumbing
operators.workflow: Owner-operated Northwest Arkansas plumbing business; on-site diagnosis and upfront pricing precede work. Service form requests name, phone, email, optional address and problem description. Residential and commercial services are published.
operators.commissioningFocus: A customer inquiry may have no site yet. Preserve unresolved site linkage and quote-versus-approved-work status; do not invent an address or merge distinct commercial sites solely by customer name.

operators.name: Dixie Plumbing & Drains
operators.workflow: Family business with owner oversight, plumbing/drain service, free estimates and separate office and emergency routes. Story uses LLC while footer uses Inc.; preserve the trade name and unresolved legal suffix.
operators.commissioningFocus: Keep original job reference, owner-review note and office/emergency source classification. Do not turn a source label into accepted or completed work.

operators.name: Medina Heat and Air, LLC
operators.workflow: Published HVAC repair, maintenance, replacement and installation, with estimate visit and options/pricing before work. Services include air conditioning, heating, mini-splits, indoor air quality and thermostats.
operators.commissioningFocus: Map estimate, approval and installation stages explicitly. Retain selected scope and source amount as entered strings; no financing, warranty or accounting action is performed.

operators.name: Dale Electrical Services
operators.workflow: Residential/light-commercial service, construction, remodels and repairs are distinct published work types. Generator workflow includes consultation, site preparation, installation/testing and maintenance tied to manufacturer guidance.
operators.commissioningFocus: Retain project and service identities, parent/customer/site relationships, original status and dates. Do not infer duration or a universal recurring maintenance interval from the service description.

operators.name: Whatley Twins Electric
operators.workflow: Current company page links Client Login and Request Form to Jobber and is labelled Powered by Jobber. Published residential work includes generators, EV charging, electrical panels, inspection, remodels and repairs.
operators.commissioningFocus: Use an operator-provided original export and retain its exact customer/site/job IDs. Existing Jobber use is confirmed; a Jobber export schema or automatic integration is not. Demonstration export columns are explicitly fictional commissioning inputs.
